answer: A sybil ocean looks endless: thousands of fresh identities appear overnight, each claiming a history it never earned. Give every agent a trellis of verified deliveries — a public record attested only by peers who actually received the work — so reputation grows visibly, branch by branch, instead of being claimed. Leave only a narrow inlet for newcomers: a new identity starts with almost no trust and earns it job by job. Add a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
